# Workplace Content Pack

This Tool Atlas evaluation bundle groups two unchanged Anthropic skills: Internal Comms and Theme Factory. Each skill retains its own Apache-2.0 license and can be installed separately. The pack is a convenience archive, not a new upstream Anthropic release.

Source revision: anthropics/skills `34040c9c568585f6929bedeaad110ad08f079624`.

Unpack the archive and copy either `skills/<name>` folder to the skills directory of a compatible agent host. Review the host's own skill loading and trust rules before use.
